name: easy-rewind
description: Local-first learning assistant for Chrome and Windows

scripts.format: prettier --write package.json .github backend/package.json desktop/package.json packages/contracts scripts docs README.md SECURITY.md
scripts.format:check: prettier --check package.json .github backend/package.json desktop/package.json packages/contracts scripts docs README.md SECURITY.md
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration
scripts.test:unit: npm run test:workspace && npm run test:containment && npm run test:hygiene
scripts.test:integration: npm run test:backend && npm run test:backend:legacy-safe
scripts.build: npm run validate:extension && node --check backend/server.js && node --check desktop/main.js
scripts.rebuild:native: npm run install:electron && npm --workspace desktop run rebuild:native
scripts.verify: npm run verify:stage1 && npm run verify:stage2
scripts.verify:stage1: npm run scan:secrets && npm run check:hygiene && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm test && npm run build
scripts.verify:stage2: npm run test:requirements && npm --workspace backend test && npm run test:contracts && npm run test:migrations && npm run test:lifecycle && npm run verify:native && npm run audit:production && npm run scan:secrets && npm run check:hygiene
